description: This file contains a script for generating markdown documentation files from header files (.h) and JSON files in a specified project directory structure. It includes functions for converting header files to markdown, converting JSON plugin descriptions to markdown, and postprocessing markdown files to clean up link references. It is a utility script used within the documentation generation workflow of a larger software project.
external_files: // to be interpreted as dynamic JSON plugin files based on folder

methods.name: generate_md(logfile=None)
methods.description: Generates markdown files from header files or JSON files in plugin folders under the 'apis' directory.

methods.name: convert_json_to_md(plugin_path)
methods.description: Converts JSON plugin description files into markdown documentation.

methods.name: convert_h_to_md(plugin_path, logfile=None)
methods.description: Converts header files within a plugin directory into markdown documentation.

methods.name: postprocess_md()
methods.description: Post-processes generated markdown files to clean up link references.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point that orchestrates the documentation generation workflow.
